Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
every six months bases as indicated by M6 in the title block.
The Cathodic Protection function is to protect the metallic parts from 
corrosion,
this protection can be found in the following places:
Beside the Nile water pumps, Beside the compensation tanks, the 400 Volt room for gas units, 
and the fire fighting building.
The first draft initiated by eng Abdel Gayed Abdel Wahab, tested by eng. Saad 
ElSayed Rageh, reviewed by eng. Mahmoud Abdel Hamid El Kholy, revised by EDEPC 
inspection & quality control eng. Adel Abdel Qader el Nagar, accepted by eng. 
Yousry Ahmed Abdel Maksoud, approved by eng. Awad Fathi Head sector of Talkha 
PS.
This document accepted by EDEPC MPIS Coordinator 
eng. Samir Abdel Gilil, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman 
admin. and financial inspection quality controls general director, and 
supervisor of EDEPC inspection and quality controls head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be well trained and 
 qualified or directly supervised by any one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 breathing mask, safety glasses 
 ... etc.
Tools and Equipments
Safety helmet, shoes, ... etc
Complete tool set, air blower
Megger, multimeter
AC & DC
 Voltmeter, Clamp meter (AC ammeter)
Work to be Carried out
Step # | Description | Test Results
1. | Clean the system component from dust | 
2. | Make the 
 primary usual inspection | 
3. | Check the fuses | 
4. | Check the AC input | 
5. | Check the rectifier | 
6. | Check the wire connection 
 for tightening |
